function.name: MEMSET
function.param: Value to assign to all bytes of that zone
Size in bytes of the memory zone
function.abstract: It fills a memory zone of size BYTES located in MEM with VALUE

description.p: This advanced function fills a memory zone of size BYTES from value indicated by VALUE. This function is useful to fill dynamic memory blocks reserved by , however it can be useful too to modify graphs of 8 bits using .
